_doc: One record per SKU/model of a USB-C GaN wall charger. Unknown = null, never false. Every non-null fact should be backed by an entry in `sources` and its field name in `field_sources`.

record.product_name: string, marketing name, e.g. Anker Nano Charger (65W)
model_numbers: string, e.g. A2663; include regional/colour variants
record.port_sharing: string|null, free-text power split table, e.g. 'C1+C2: 45+20; C1+A: 45+18'
record.pps_max_w: number|null, the highest wattage reachable via PPS
other_protocols: string, e.g. QC3.0, AFC, FCP, SCP, Apple 2.4A
record.notes: string|null, gaps and contradictions between sources
